theorem arc_chars_star {x : ℝ} (hx : 4.9e26 ≤ x) {q : ℕ} (hq1 : 1 ≤ q) (hqt : (qt q : ℝ) ≤ 300000)
    {β : ℝ} (hβ : |β * x| ≤ 1200000 / qt q) :
    ((if Squarefree q then (1:ℝ) else 0) / q.totient * ‖expTsum (coprimePart q (cU (x / κ))) β‖ ^ 2 ≤
        ∑ b ∈ Bset q, ‖expTsum (coprimePart q (cU (x / κ))) ((b : ℝ) / q + β)‖ ^ 2 ∧
      ∑ b ∈ Bset q, ‖expTsum (coprimePart q (cU (x / κ))) ((b : ℝ) / q + β)‖ ^ 2 ≤
        (if Squarefree q then (1:ℝ) else 0) / q.totient * ‖expTsum (coprimePart q (cU (x / κ))) β‖ ^ 2 +
          (1.49e-6 * (x / κ)) ^ 2) ∧
      ‖expTsum (coprimePart q (cU (x / κ))) β -
        𝓕 (fun u => (etaU u : ℂ)) (-(β * (x / κ))) * ((x / κ : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1.49e-6 * (x / κ) :=

note: Lean proves the corollary only for y ≥ 10²⁵ with |E| ≤ 10⁻¹⁷ + 4.7·10⁶/(√q√y), which the book's bound implies (381500/√q + 76 ≤ 4.7·10⁶/√q for q ≤ 3·10⁵). major_arcs_input and minor_arcs_input cite it but state Ch. 14 results, not this corollary.
